frame_row: Document-grounded proposal; no RTL hierarchy is asserted.

label: u_vlsit_axi_llc
(m_vlsit_axi_llc)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Supplies shared-cache requests and memory traffic; the ACE profile must define how LLC AXI traffic participates in external coherence.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_ace_proxy
(m_vlsit_riscv_ace_proxy)
NEW
blocks.function: Bridges external ACE transactions and inward snoops to the local coherence domain; response, data and ordering policy must be fixed before RTL.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_ace_probe_router
(m_vlsit_riscv_ace_probe_router)
NEW
blocks.function: Fans out snoop work to active local caches and collects clean/dirty responses and data for the proxy.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_coh_fabric
(m_vlsit_riscv_coh_fabric)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Owns local multi-hart coherence and must expose a complete local-probe transaction contract to the ACE adapter.

interfaces.name: LLC to ACE profile adapter
interfaces.signals: Mapping between LLC AXI master traffic and external coherent ACE transactions is an open design decision; no pass-through equivalence is assumed.

interfaces.name: External snoop service
interfaces.signals: ACE AC requests are translated to local probes; CR/CD responses and acknowledge semantics follow the chosen supported ACE subset.

interfaces.name: Local cache probe service
interfaces.signals: Probe request, per-hart response and dirty-line data; fields and timing must be defined from the pinned cache/CCU ports.

interfaces.name: External full ACE boundary
interfaces.signals: Fixed ACE port set is listed in Section 6; supported transaction subset and outstanding limits remain DEP-002.

interfaces.name: Shared LLC boundary
interfaces.signals: AXI4 cache request and response service.

interfaces.name: Cluster clock/reset
interfaces.signals: Synchronized reset deassertion is owned by the SoC.

legend_note: PULP ace_ccu_top is a reuse candidate documented as an ACE interconnector, not a proven drop-in for the selected Culsans/HPDcache configuration. Keep the VLSIT proxy classified NEW until interface and behavior compatibility is demonstrated. Status codes: REUSE = upstream RTL reused; REUSE* = reuse candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation, wrapper, or macro binding; NEW = VLSIT RTL to design; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the selected generator. All proposed blocks are dashed because this cluster has no pinned integrated RTL yet.
